title: DZY Loves Physics
statementMd:
*DZY loves Physics, and he enjoys calculating density.*

Almost everything has density, even a graph. We define the density of a non-directed graph (nodes and edges of the graph have some values) as follows:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ddc049109c41af6c53df4e3447546ae396059ce4.png)

where

*v*

is the sum of the values of the nodes,

*e*

is the sum of the values of the edges.

Once DZY got a graph $*G*$, now he wants to find a connected induced subgraph $*G*'$ of the graph, such that the density of $*G*'$ is as large as possible.

An induced subgraph $*G*'(*V*', *E*')$ of a graph $*G*(*V*, *E*)$ is a graph that satisfies:

- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/46e20b4dfc895713f2da511b00037f3b583b7786.png);
- edge ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3323e65c2bb0e7b15e71bc8acf5bbdd103bbd406.png) if and only if ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ff784919ccab7c1de161efd8c454dd842ca9a194.png), and edge ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5bd600027111301384bc3bf759bd32d812f393dd.png);
- the value of an edge in $*G*'$ is the same as the value of the corresponding edge in $*G*$, so as the value of a node.

Help DZY to find the induced subgraph with maximum density. Note that the induced subgraph you choose must be connected.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1252c805e97e9fa5fc53301fd7c5c88f2bc08313.png)

## Input

The first line contains two space-separated integers $*n* (1 ≤ *n* ≤ 500)$, ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bed2d5acbcccaf59b2f85a26a90ab00d2b92e1c4.png). Integer $*n*$ represents the number of nodes of the graph $*G*$, $*m*$ represents the number of edges.

The second line contains $*n*$ space-separated integers $*x*_{*i*} (1 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6})$, where $*x*_{*i*}$ represents the value of the $*i*$-th node. Consider the graph nodes are numbered from $1$ to $*n*$.

Each of the next $*m*$ lines contains three space-separated integers $*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}, *c*_{*i*} (1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} < *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*; 1 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{3})$, denoting an edge between node $*a*_{*i*}$ and $*b*_{*i*}$ with value $*c*_{*i*}$. The graph won't contain multiple edges.

## Output

Output a real number denoting the answer, with an absolute or relative error of at most $10^{ - 9}$.

## Note

In the first sample, you can only choose an empty subgraph, or the subgraph containing only node $1$.

In the second sample, choosing the whole graph is optimal.
statementZhMd:
*DZY 喜欢物理，并且他喜欢计算密度。*

几乎所有东西都有密度，甚至图也不例外。我们将一个无向图的密度定义如下（图中的节点和边都具有各自的值）：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ddc049109c41af6c53df4e3447546ae396059ce4.png)

其中，

*v*

是节点值之和，

*e*

是边值之和。

DZY 得到了一个图 $*G*$，现在他想找出该图的一个连通导出子图 $*G*'$，使得 $*G*'$ 的密度尽可能大。

图 $*G*(*V*, *E*)$ 的导出子图 $*G*'(*V*', *E*')$ 是满足以下条件的图：

- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/46e20b4dfc895713f2da511b00037f3b583b7786.png)；
- 当且仅当 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ff784919ccab7c1de161efd8c454dd842ca9a194.png) 且 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5bd600027111301384bc3bf759bd32d812f393dd.png) 时，存在边 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3323e65c2bb0e7b15e71bc8acf5bbdd103bbd406.png)；
- $*G*'$ 中一条边的值与 $*G*$ 中对应边的值相同，节点的值也相同。

请帮助 DZY 找到密度最大的导出子图。注意，你选择的导出子图必须是连通的。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1252c805e97e9fa5fc53301fd7c5c88f2bc08313.png)

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $*n* (1 ≤ *n* ≤ 500)$ 和 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bed2d5acbcccaf59b2f85a26a90ab00d2b92e1c4.png)。整数 $*n*$ 表示图 $*G*$ 中节点的数量，$*m*$ 表示边的数量。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个用空格分隔的整数 $*x*_{*i*} (1 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6})$，其中 $*x*_{*i*}$ 表示第 $*i*$ 个节点的值。图中的节点编号为 $1$ 到 $*n*$。

接下来的 $*m*$ 行中，每行包含三个用空格分隔的整数 $*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}, *c*_{*i*} (1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} < *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*; 1 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{3})$，表示一条连接节点 $*a*_{*i*}$ 和节点 $*b*_{*i*}$、值为 $*c*_{*i*}$ 的边。图中不存在重边。

## 输出格式

输出一个实数表示答案。绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 9}$。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，你只能选择空子图，或者只包含节点 $1$ 的子图。

在第二个样例中，选择整个图是最优的。
